environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with Pod Security Admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. The pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/report-svc.json which denies the execve, execveat, clone3, and fork syscalls (in addition to the restricted PSA baseline). The container runs as non-root UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, and capabilities dropped (ALL). A writable emptyDir is mounted at /tmp/reports for output. The IRSA-bound service account has no IAM permissions beyond ECR pull.

config.runtime: EKS 1.28, containerd 1.7, pod security admission 'restricted' enforced
config.seccomp_profile: /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/report-svc.json with deny list: execve, execveat, clone3, fork, vfork, clone
